# LollipopBarChart

## Overview

`LollipopBarChart` is a top-level compound chart component that composes `ChartHeader`, `ChartLegend`, `DataDisplay`, `LollipopBarGroup`, and `ChartFooter` into a complete lollipop bar visualization. It follows the **Organized Props Pattern** with two layers: Parent Props and Child Configs.

A lollipop chart is a less ink-heavy alternative to a standard bar chart — each category is represented by a vertical stem with a circular dot. All tokens resolve from the `@layer brand` CSS cascade; no JS resolver.

## Figma Reference

- **Node ID**: `274:11306`
- **Design File**: DataVis-Components
- **Figma URL**: https://www.figma.com/design/uA5ExvS0cNXbDEKzT9Rnrt/DataVis-Components?node-id=274-11306

## Architecture

```
LollipopBarChart (Layer 2 booleans + Layer 3 *Config objects)
│
├── Layer 2 — Parent Props
│   ├── chartHeader       → toggles ChartHeader
│   ├── chartFooter       → toggles ChartFooter
│   ├── chartLegend       → toggles ChartLegend
│   ├── dataDisplay       → toggles DataDisplay
│   ├── interactive       → enables hover/click
│   ├── animated          → enables entry animation
│   └── fullWidth         → fill container width
│
├── Layer 3 — Child Component Configs
│   ├── chartHeaderConfig  → { chartTitleValue, chartSubtitleValue }
│   ├── chartLegendConfig  → { items, categoryLabelValue, type, dataHead, dataHeadConfig }
│   ├── dataDisplayConfig  → { mode, mainLabelValue, dataHead, badgeConfig, ... }
│   ├── barGroupConfig     → { topLabels, yAxis, avgLine, hoverBadge, dataSort, yAxisConfig, ... }
│   └── chartFooterConfig  → { annotationLeftValue, annotationRightValue }
│
└── Render Tree
    ├── ChartAccessibility (role="figure", auto-summary, hidden data table, aria-live region)
    │   │   └── liveText ← useChartAccessibility({ rawLiveText, ... })
    │   ├── ChartHeader (conditional: chartHeader)
    │   ├── ChartLegend (conditional: chartLegend)
    │   ├── DataDisplay (conditional: dataDisplay, id={dataDisplayId})
    │   │   ├── mainLabel (inline typography tokens)
    │   │   ├── DataHead (DataLead + SupportingData + SupportingLabel)
    │   │   └── Badge (change indicator via badgeConfig)
    │   ├── LollipopBarGroup (D3 calculations, layout, ariaControlsId)
    │   │   ├── YAxis (tick positioning from D3 scale, aria-hidden baked in)
    │   │   ├── AvgLine (optional, aria-hidden="true")
    │   │   ├── contentWrapper (role="group", aria-label="Chart data")
    │   │   │   └── LollipopBar[] (data-roving-item, useRovingTabIndex)
    │   │   │       ├── ShapeRect (dot shape)
    │   │   │       ├── Line (stem)
    │   │   │       └── category + value labels
    │   │   └── HoverBadge (optional, follows cursor, aria-hidden baked in)
    │   └── ChartFooter (conditional: chartFooter)
```

**Token resolution**: All colours resolve from `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-{n}` CSS custom properties injected by the Convex → `generateDataVisCSS` → `useStyleInjection` → `@layer brand` pipeline. Brand, theme, platform, and density are applied globally — the chart component has no knowledge of Figma variable collections.

## Import

```tsx
import { LollipopBarChart } from './LollipopBarChart';
// Or from the package root:
import { LollipopBarChart } from '@oneui/datavis';
```

## Data Formats

Supports both canonical and legacy formats:

```tsx
// Canonical (recommended)
const data: ChartDataPoint[] = [
  { category: 'Jan', value: 120 },
  { category: 'Feb', value: 180, colorIndex: 2 },
];

// Legacy (deprecated, still supported)
const legacyData = [
  { label: 'Jan', value: 120 },
  { label: 'Feb', value: 180 },
];
```

## Props Interface

```typescript
export interface LollipopBarChartProps {
  // Layer 2: Parent props
  data: ChartDataPoint[] | DataPoint[];
  width?: number | string;
  height?: number | string;
  chartHeader?: boolean;
  chartFooter?: boolean;
  chartLegend?: boolean;
  dataDisplay?: boolean;
  interactive?: boolean;
  animated?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;

  // Layer 3: Child configs
  chartHeaderConfig?: ChartHeaderConfig;
  chartLegendConfig?: ChartLegendConfig;
  dataDisplayConfig?: DataDisplayConfig;
  barGroupConfig?: BarGroupConfig;
  chartFooterConfig?: ChartFooterConfig;

  accessibility?: AccessibilityConfig;
}
```

## Props

### Layer 2: Parent Props

| Prop          | Type                              | Default | Description                                       |
| ------------- | --------------------------------- | ------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `data`        | `ChartDataPoint[] \| DataPoint[]` | `[]`    | Chart data (canonical or legacy format)           |
| `width`       | `number \| string`                | `420`   | Total chart width in px or CSS string             |
| `height`      | `number \| string`                | `500`   | Total chart height in px or CSS string            |
| `chartHeader` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Toggle ChartHeader                                |
| `chartFooter` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Toggle ChartFooter                                |
| `chartLegend` | `boolean`                         | `false` | Toggle ChartLegend                                |
| `dataDisplay` | `boolean`                         | `false` | Toggle DataDisplay above chart                    |
| `interactive` | `boolean`                         | `true`  | Enable hover/click interactivity                  |
| `animated`    | `boolean`                         | `false` | Enable entry animation (staggered grow + fade-in) |
| `fullWidth`   | `boolean`                         | `false` | Fill available container width (`width: 100%`)    |

### Layer 3: Child Configs

#### `chartHeaderConfig`

| Prop                 | Type     | Default     | Description         |
| -------------------- | -------- | ----------- | ------------------- |
| `chartTitleValue`    | `string` | `undefined` | Chart title text    |
| `chartSubtitleValue` | `string` | `undefined` | Chart subtitle text |

#### `chartLegendConfig`

| Prop                 | Type                             | Default        | Description                     |
| -------------------- | -------------------------------- | -------------- | ------------------------------- |
| `items`              | `ChartLegendItem[]`              | auto-generated | Manual legend items             |
| `categoryLabelValue` | `string`                         | —              | Simple single-item legend label |
| `type`               | `"circle" \| "dashed" \| "line"` | `"circle"`     | Indicator type                  |
| `dataHead`           | `boolean`                        | `false`        | Toggle DataHead in legend items |
| `dataHeadConfig`     | `object`                         | `{}`           | DataHead config for legend      |

**Auto-generation**: When neither `items` nor `categoryLabelValue` is provided, legend items are auto-generated from data. Each data point maps to a CSS variable (`var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`).

#### `barGroupConfig`

| Prop                    | Type                       | Default      | Description                                                                                           |
| ----------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `topLabels`             | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle value labels above dots                                                                        |
| `categoryLabels`        | `boolean`                  | `true`       | Toggle category labels below                                                                          |
| `yAxis`                 | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle Y-axis                                                                                         |
| `avgLine`               | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle average line                                                                                   |
| `hoverBadge`            | `boolean`                  | `false`      | Toggle cursor-following hover badge                                                                   |
| `valueFormat`           | `ValueFormatConfig`        | —            | Auto-format all values                                                                                |
| `barWidth`              | `string`                   | `"M"`        | Dot size (XS–2XL)                                                                                     |
| `onBarHover`            | `(data) => void`           | —            | Hover callback                                                                                        |
| `onBarClick`            | `(data) => void`           | —            | Click callback                                                                                        |
| `highlightedBarIndices` | `number[]`                 | —            | Indices of lollipops rendered at full opacity; every other dims (multi-bar highlight)                 |
| `hoveredBarIndex`       | `number \| number[]`       | —            | Back-compat alias for `highlightedBarIndices`. Accepts single index or array                          |
| `yAxisConfig`           | `LollipopYAxisConfig`      | —            | `{ tickCount, formatValue, valueFormat, yAxisLabel, yAxisLabelValue, axisTickSkipper, skippedTicks }` |

##### `categoryLabelConfig`

Controls dynamic category label behavior including word truncation, multi-line wrapping, and overflow grouping into an "Others" lollipop.

| Prop                     | Type                                | Default       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `maxWords`               | `number`                            | `3`           | Maximum words per label before truncation with "…"                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `maxLines`               | `number`                            | `2`           | Maximum display lines per label (enables word-wrap)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `othersLabel`            | `string`                            | `"Others"`    | Label text for the overflow group                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| `overflowType`           | `"grouped" \| "truncated" \| "all"` | `"truncated"` | `"truncated"` (default): bars that don't fit are removed from the right. `"grouped"`: overflow items aggregated into an "Others" lollipop. `"all"`: every bar is rendered but in-between category labels are skipped to prevent overlap (hovering any bar — including those with hidden labels — reveals the full category name in the HoverBadge and the `onBarHover` callback) |
| `skippedLabels`          | `"auto" \| number`                  | `"auto"`      | Only used when `overflowType` is `"all"`. `"auto"` dynamically calculates which labels to show based on available width. A `number` sets an explicit skip interval (e.g., `1` = every other label)                                                                                                                                                                               |
| `enableOverflowGrouping` | `boolean`                           | `false`       | **Deprecated** — use `overflowType` instead. `true` maps to `"grouped"`, `false` maps to `"truncated"`                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `labelWidth`             | `"fluid" \| number`                 | `"fluid"`     | Label sizing: fluid (fill space with gaps) or fixed px                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| `othersPosition`         | `"sorted" \| "end"`                 | `"sorted"`    | Position of Others: by value or pinned to far right                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| `othersHeight`           | `"relative" \| "full" \| number`    | `"relative"`  | Height mode for the Others lollipop                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

## Usage Examples

### Basic Chart

```tsx
import { LollipopBarChart } from './LollipopBarChart';

<LollipopBarChart
  data={[
    { category: 'Jan', value: 120 },
    { category: 'Feb', value: 180 },
    { category: 'Mar', value: 90 },
  ]}
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Monthly Revenue',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Q1 2024 Performance',
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Analytics',
    annotationRightValue: '*In thousands USD',
  }}
/>
```

### Full Featured Chart

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={canonicalData}
  width={500}
  height={550}
  chartHeader
  chartFooter
  chartLegend
  dataDisplay
  chartHeaderConfig={{
    chartTitleValue: 'Regional Performance',
    chartSubtitleValue: 'Revenue by region with KPI overview',
  }}
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Hover a lollipop',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    topLabels: true,
    categoryLabels: true,
    yAxis: true,
    avgLine: true,
    hoverBadge: true,
    barWidth: 'M',
    valueFormat: { type: 'currency', currency: 'GBP' },
  }}
  chartFooterConfig={{
    annotationLeftValue: 'Source: Regional Reports',
    annotationRightValue: '*Preliminary figures',
  }}
  accessibility={{
    enabled: true,
    dataTable: true,
  }}
/>
```

### Full Width

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart data={data} fullWidth barGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true }} />
```

### With Entry Animation

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart data={data} animated barGroupConfig={{ yAxis: true }} />
```

### Sorted Bars (Descending)

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={data}
  barGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    dataSort: 'desc',
  }}
/>
```

### Hover-Driven DataDisplay

```tsx
<LollipopBarChart
  data={data}
  dataDisplay
  dataDisplayConfig={{
    mode: 'hover',
    mainLabelValue: 'Select a data point',
    dataHead: {
      dataLeadValue: '—',
    },
    badgeConfig: {
      value: '—',
      autoDetect: true,
    },
    formatHoverLeadValue: (value) => `£${value.toLocaleString()}`,
    formatHoverBadgeValue: (value, _category) => {
      const pct = ((value / total) * 100).toFixed(1);
      return `${pct}%`;
    },
  }}
  barGroupConfig={{
    yAxis: true,
    barWidth: 'M',
  }}
/>
```

## Design Tokens Used

| Token                              | Purpose                    | Notes                                            |
| ---------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------ |
| `--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1…12`  | Lollipop dot and stem fill | Injected by `generateDataVisCSS` via `@layer brand` |
| `--Spacing-5`                      | Gap between chart sections | Via `--LollipopBarChart-sectionGap` CSS override hook |

All child components resolve their own tokens from the global `@layer brand` cascade. No token values are passed as props.

## Legend Auto-Generation

When `chartLegend` is `true` and no `chartLegendConfig.items` or `chartLegendConfig.categoryLabelValue` is provided:

1. **Custom colors in data**: Groups by unique color, creates one legend item per color.
2. **Default**: Creates one legend item per data point (up to 12) using `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-1)` through `var(--DataVis-Categorical-Bold-12)`.

## Animation

When `animated={true}`, lollipops grow from zero on first load (entry animation with stagger). After entry settles, subsequent data changes transition smoothly. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for token details.

## Negative Data

The chart supports mixed positive/negative datasets. `LollipopBarGroup` auto-detects negative values and renders a ZeroLine with positive lollipops growing upward and negative lollipops hanging downward. Transitions between positive-only, mixed, and negative-only data are animated when `animated={true}`. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for details.

## Sparse Data

When the dataset has 1–3 entries, `LollipopBarGroup` automatically adds grey placeholder lollipops to fill 5 total slots, preventing awkward stretching. See **[LollipopBarGroup.md](./LollipopBarGroup.md)** for details.

## Height Behavior

The `height` prop sets the total chart container height. LollipopBarGroup fills the remaining vertical space after header, legend, DataDisplay, and footer.

## Hover Interaction

Hovering over lollipop bars highlights the bar and can drive DataDisplay and HoverBadge updates. Set `interactive={true}` (default) and optionally `barGroupConfig.hoverBadge` to show a cursor-following badge.

## DataDisplay Integration

This chart supports an optional DataDisplay component above the chart body. When `dataDisplayConfig.mode` is `"hover"`, values update based on the hovered lollipop:

- `mainLabelValue` → set to the hovered category name
- `dataHead.dataLeadValue` → set to the formatted value
- `badgeConfig.value` → set to the percentage of total (or custom formatted)

## Accessibility

Wrapped by `ChartAccessibility` (enabled by default). Configure via the `accessibility` prop.

### Accessibility Architecture

| Level | Feature                              | Description                                                                         |
| ----- | ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Chart | `ChartAccessibility`                 | `role="figure"`, auto-summary, hidden data table, `aria-live` region                |
| Chart | `useChartAccessibility`              | Debounced screen-reader announcements on hover/focus (composes `useAriaLiveRegion`) |
| Chart | `dataDisplayId` + `ariaControlsId`   | Links bars to DataDisplay via `aria-controls` (id from `useChartAccessibility`)     |
| Group | `useRovingTabIndex`                  | ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keyboard navigation between lollipops                          |
| Group | `role="group"`                       | Content wrapper announced as a logical group                                        |
| Group | `aria-hidden="true"`                 | AvgLine wrapper hidden from assistive technology                                    |
| Bar   | `role="button"` + `data-roving-item` | Interactive lollipops are focusable with keyboard and screen reader support         |
| Bar   | `aria-roledescription="data point"`  | Semantic role for screen readers                                                    |
| Bar   | `aria-label`                         | `"{category}: {value}, bar N of M"` — full context per lollipop                     |

### ARIA Live Region

When a lollipop is hovered or focused, a debounced announcement is sent to the `aria-live="polite"` region inside `ChartAccessibility`:

```
"{category}, {formattedValue}, {percentOfTotal}% of total"
```

The `useChartAccessibility` hook debounces updates by 150ms to prevent rapid-fire announcements when arrowing through bars.

### aria-controls Linking

A stable `dataDisplayId` returned by `useChartAccessibility` is set as `id` on the `DataDisplay` component and passed as `ariaControlsId` to `LollipopBarGroup`. Each bar receives this as `ariaControls`, so screen readers announce the relationship between bars and the data summary panel.

## Migration from Previous API

| Old Prop / Config                             | New Prop / Config                                 |
| --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------- |
| `modes={{ fullWidth: true }}`                 | `fullWidth={true}`                                |
| `modes={{ colourMode, colourTheme, ... }}`    | **Removed** — globally injected via `@layer brand` |
| `dataDisplayConfig.dataBadgeSemanticConfig`   | `dataDisplayConfig.badgeConfig`                   |
| `badgeConfig.dataBadgeSemanticValue`          | `badgeConfig.value`                               |
| `dataDisplayConfig.dataBadgeSemantic`         | `dataDisplayConfig.showBadge`                     |
| `dataDisplayConfig.size: "S" \| "M"`     | `dataDisplayConfig.size: "XS" \| "S" \| "M" \| "L" \| "XL"` |
| `import LollipopBarChart from '...'` (default) | `import { LollipopBarChart } from '...'` (named)  |
| `showHeader`                                  | `chartHeader`                                     |
| `showFooter`                                  | `chartFooter`                                     |
| `showLegend`                                  | `chartLegend`                                     |
| `showDataDisplay`                             | `dataDisplay`                                     |
| `chartHeader: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartHeaderConfig: { ... }`                      |
| `chartLegend: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartLegendConfig: { ... }`                      |
| `barGroup: { ... }`                           | `barGroupConfig: { ... }`                         |
| `chartFooter: { ... }` (object prop)          | `chartFooterConfig: { ... }`                      |
